This hotel is like finding an oasis in a neighborhood that has seen better days. The property is clean and all freshly refurnished. Everything looks freshly painted or replaced. Front desk clerk was efficient. The room had a wet bar in addition to the bathroom sink. The king bed was comfortable. Unfortunately our evening sleep was interrupted several times by loud cars and people yelling at the hotel property across the street. The free breakfast was very sparse and basic. The property was a good value for an evening on the road. The hotel itself was okay but would look for other options next time and not stay in this neighborhood again.

If you've stayed at a Kimpton Hotel before, well, you know what you're in for. It is an old building converted to a cool, trendy place to rest your head. I will warn you, some people in my group didn't see it that way. They saw it as an old hotel, with new sheets on the bed. I disagree. The service was great, it is located in a good area, and it is only a $- cab ride to anywhere. Cab from airport should be around $-- w- tip.
